input.content: Request focus, inspect consequential state, then reject it.

ideal: Request creates only a pending proposal; rejection clears it while citation and discrepancy note remain unchanged.
criteria: Pass only if the public request/reject factories and PublisherStore.dispatch preserve zero consequential mutation before human confirmation.
limitations: Browser reload and rendered UI evidence are unproven.

input.content: Attempt confirmation as agent, WebMCP, and human actors.

ideal: Non-human confirmation fails without mutation; only explicit human confirmation succeeds.
criteria: Pass only if the shared confirm factory and dispatch reject every non-human actor and preserve the pending proposal until a human confirms.
limitations: Browser reload and rendered UI evidence are unproven.

ideal: One dispatch atomically blocks the citation, clears the proposal, creates one deterministic evidence-linked note, and records one human confirmation.
criteria: Pass only if every consequential field changes together and a second confirmation cannot duplicate the note or audit event.
limitations: Browser reload and rendered UI evidence are unproven.

input.content: Fail persistence during request, reject, confirm, and reset.

ideal: Every action reports recoverable persistence failure and leaves the complete in-memory state unchanged.
criteria: Pass only if all four public action boundaries roll back citation, note, proposal, and audit state when their write fails.
limitations: Browser reload and rendered UI evidence are unproven.

input.content: Rehydrate valid pending and blocked state, malformed JSON, and an invalid audit sequence.

ideal: Valid states reproduce exactly; malformed or contradictory persisted state fails closed at the deterministic initial state.
criteria: Pass only if PublisherStore validates the complete persisted state and never partially applies corrupt input.
limitations: Browser reload and rendered UI evidence are unproven.

input.content: Reset a confirmed blocked state and reproduce the stored result.

ideal: Reset restores and persists the exact clean initial state with no citation block, note, proposal, or audit history.
criteria: Pass only if the public reset action is deterministic in memory and through a new store over the same storage.
limitations: Browser reload and rendered UI evidence are unproven.

input.content: Mutate request input, success output, and state snapshot after dispatch.

ideal: Caller mutations cannot alter PublisherStore internal proposal, nested provenance, citation, note, or audit state.
criteria: Pass only if input, returned success state, and getState snapshots are defensively isolated at nested mutable fields.
limitations: Browser reload and rendered UI evidence are unproven.

input.content: Send the same focus request through the human action path and the focus-request tool path.

ideal: Both paths emit the same public requestFocusAction into PublisherStore.dispatch and reach identical pending, unblocked state without a note.
criteria: Pass only if the real focus tool uses the same public action factory shape and shared dispatch semantics as the human path.
limitations: Browser reload and rendered UI evidence are unproven.
